activation_base_rule: exact current integration head that records T07, T08, T10 and T11 APPROVED, contains T10/T11 accepted sources in its ancestry, and has released all dependency path ownership
activation_steps: Verify authoritative integration branch is codex/havenline-sequential-task-01.
Verify T07, T08, T10 and T11 are APPROVED in dependency graph, workstream registry and task gates.
Verify the current integration head contains accepted T10 and T11 completion/integration records.
Verify T10 and T11 are no longer listed as active owners before T12 activation.
Reconcile UPSTREAM_BINDINGS/PREBUILD_CONTRACT/TASK_PACKET assumptions against the exact accepted T10/T11 public interfaces and stable IDs.

Create Docs/Production/T12/BINDING_RESOLUTION.json from BINDING_RESOLUTION_TEMPLATE.json, populate exact accepted T10/T11 integrated sources and repository-backed public-ID pointer evidence, set status RESOLVED_FOR_ACTIVATION and promotion_allowed true only when complete.

Set BASE=<exact current integration head> in a full-history checkout, then run python tools/havenline/task12/verify_binding_resolution.py --resolution Docs/Production/T12/BINDING_RESOLUTION.json --require-resolved --activation-head <BASE> and require PASS, including accepted-source ancestry and byte-identical upstream JSON proof.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_level_matrix.py and require PASS; LEVEL_1_100_MATRIX.json remains preparation input and is never copied directly into shipping data.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/reference_progression_oracle.py --input Docs/Production/T12/FULL_ENGINE_VECTOR_CORPUS.json and require PASS for all 398 full-chain vectors.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/materialize_progression_data.py in dry-run mode and require PASS; no shipping files may be written before the T12 workstream is claimed on the activation base.

Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_fact_slot_binding_index.py and require PASS; Levels 2-100 must have exactly 99 unresolved typed fact-slot bindings and T11 public IDs must remain empty until approval.

Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_authoring_blueprint.py and require PASS; it must prove the 100-level authoring blueprint/fact-slot catalog deterministically expand the frozen matrix and materialize into shipping-shaped data that passes the real validator.

Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_reference_runtime_semantics.py and require PASS; out-of-order authoritative facts must be retained without prerequisite skipping, deterministic settlement must be ascending/fixed-point, and snapshot/restore must preserve fact-slot causality without duplicate events.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_runtime_interface.py and require PASS so T12-owned API/authority boundaries remain frozen.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_traceability.py and require PASS so every T12-R01..R16 requirement retains tests/evidence/critic coverage.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_downstream_contract.py and require PASS so T13/T14/T32/T44-T52/T62 consumer boundaries remain frozen.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_data_schema.py and require PASS so future shipping level/milestone/binding structure and authority boundaries remain frozen.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/reference_progression_oracle.py and require PASS so future Godot behavior must match the prepared pure/idempotent engine vectors.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_candidate_evidence.py and require template PASS; the resolved packet is a future candidate-review gate, not an activation prerequisite.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_critic_review_records.py and require template PASS; resolved critic records are a future review/final-disposition gate, not an activation prerequisite.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/validate_evidence_index.py and require template PASS; the resolved digest index is a future final-disposition gate, not an activation prerequisite.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/fuzz_progression_contract.py and require PASS so representative malformed progressions continue failing closed.
Run python tools/havenline/task12/benchmark_prebuild_validators.py and require PASS as a preparation-tooling hygiene check only; this never substitutes for shipping C6.
Run python -m unittest discover -s tools/havenline/task12/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v and require PASS.
Run tools/havenline/task12/prepare_activation.py --activate --base <current-integration-head>.
Apply the emitted @reservation:T12 PATH_OWNERSHIP patch through the integration owner.
Claim T12 with workstream.py as ASSIGNED using the exact current integration head and @reservation:T12.
Set T12 dependency-graph/task-gate active state consistently through integration-owner governance update.
Validate registry and planned ownership collision checks.
Create havenline/T12-progression-architecture from the exact post-activation integration head.
Require candidate guard PASS before shipping T12 runtime/data expands.

Require the future Godot T12 test harness to emit ENGINE_PARITY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json-shaped results for the exact candidate SHA and pass compare_engine_parity.py against ENGINE_TEST_VECTORS.json before candidate review.

Once shipping progression data exists, seed candidate provenance only with initialize_candidate_evidence.py using exact activation base, candidate SHA, trusted integration-head SHA used by workstream.py validate-candidate, resolved T10/T11 bindings, authorized changed-file manifest reference and real shipping file hashes. The initializer must leave every acceptance field pending.

Require completed critic records derived from CRITIC_REVIEW_RECORD_TEMPLATE.json to pass validate_critic_review_records.py --require-resolved. Every one of the 29 mandatory T12-specific dimensions must be individually >9.0 with evidence and no unresolved defect; no average can waive a failing dimension. C2/C3/C4/C7 require independent reviewer-runtime provenance; C6 remains quantitative specialist.
Populate the candidate evidence packet with real evidence and require validate_candidate_evidence.py --require-resolved PASS before final candidate disposition.

Build EVIDENCE_INDEX_TEMPLATE.json into a resolved EVIDENCE_INDEX_COMPLETE manifest containing every evidence URI referenced by the candidate packet and critic records exactly once, with exact SHA-256, exact candidate source, producer identity and content_verified=true; require validate_evidence_index.py --require-resolved PASS.

Run final_candidate_gate.py from the exact candidate checkout with the resolved candidate evidence packet, critic records, exact engine-parity output, complete evidence digest index, resolved T10/T11 binding record and the actual shipping levels/milestones/bindings files. Require PASS; the gate must revalidate all three shipping datasets, accepted binding ancestry/blob identity, checked-out candidate identity, the live canonical workstream.py candidate guard, evidence completeness/digests, shipping hashes, T10/T11 sources, critic minima/provenance and parity identity.

Validate every shipping-data revision with both validators: python tools/havenline/task12/validate_progression_contract.py --levels HavenlineGodot/data/progression_levels_v1.json --milestones HavenlineGodot/data/progression_milestones_v1.json and python tools/havenline/task12/validate_fact_slot_binding_index.py --input HavenlineGodot/data/progression_bindings_v1.json --shipping.
claim_template: python3 tools/havenline/production/workstream.py claim T12 --owner progression-architecture-builder --branch havenline/T12-progression-architecture --base <POST_T11_INTEGRATION_SHA> --owned-alias @reservation:T12 --status ASSIGNED
notes: T12 governance/tooling preparation may continue while remaining dependencies are unfinished; at the current checkpoint T10 is APPROVED/integrated and T11 remains unfinished. Shipping T12 runtime/data remain dependency-gated.
T12 owns Level 1–100 progression topology and cadence contracts; T13 owns adaptive difficulty/Challenge Director behavior.
T12 may consume T10/T11 public transform/camp-state IDs after approval but may not change their transaction or content semantics.
T14 owns global persistence/versioning; T33+ own economy/monetization; T44-T52 own authored connected-region content.
Parallel production is allowed only with disjoint path ownership; integration remains serial and integration-owner controlled.

The non-shipping cadence blueprint, concrete 100-level matrix, runtime interface contract, downstream consumer contract, progression-data schema, engine parity vectors/oracle/comparator, candidate-evidence template/validator/initializer, per-dimension critic record template/validator, complete evidence digest index, cross-file final candidate gate, exact-binding template, acceptance traceability, fuzz/performance hardening and validators/tests are preparation accelerators, not evidence that T12 production implementation has started.
PREBUILD_PERFORMANCE_BUDGET.json governs preparation tooling only; final C6 remains mandatory against the activated shipping candidate/integrated artifact.

After activation, the T12 shipping builder may not modify Docs/Production/T12/**, tools/havenline/task12/**, or T12 preparation workflows. Those preparation/acceptance surfaces are frozen before T11 closeout; any required change reopens pre-activation repair instead of being made by the shipping candidate.

Preativation buildout may include deterministic authoring blueprints, fact-slot contracts, dry-run materialization and exhaustive reference vectors, but must never write the seven shipping/runtime-test files before T12 is activated and claimed.

The non-shipping reference progression engine freezes state-transition behavior for out-of-order facts, deterministic cascades, duplicate no-ops and snapshot/restore; it is an oracle for the future Godot runtime, not shipping gameplay code.
